verdict.rationale: Sketch's first-party docs describe a built-in, official MCP Server: a lightweight, local-only web server that lets AI clients like ChatGPT or Claude interact directly with Sketch. The AI page adds that any MCP-compatible client can connect at no extra cost, and that agents can recreate styles and components from a repo or turn frames into code. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described, detail on setup and the exposed tool set, and any remote/hosted option (it is local-only and tied to the Mac app).
